messages.subject: workflow of camtrapR
parts:
Hello Dear group members,
I am Asghar working on mammals' diversity in my hometown Malakand. I have six-month data of Camera trap images of these mammals. Recently i read an article about the package "camtrapR". I am very enthusiastic to learn the package and want to apply for my data analysis.  From where i get started. I have installed the camtrapR pakage. also installed the Exif tool. i will be very grateful if someone share with me a stepwise video of the basic workflow of the package.  i will acknowledge their guidance and technical support in my manuscript. On daily basis i am studying the package manual but cannot execute it. I easily learn from video. Please help me in this, i will be much more thankful to all of you. 
kind regards 
Asghar
